decisions.reason: The existing message-99 MODIFY already captures the completed system-layout deliverable and its milestone-local scope; no additional change is required.
The source explicitly makes the completed wiring plan part of the clarified milestone, so the existing same-message MODIFY must also change persistence from task-local to milestone-local.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey — I wanted to quickly clarify the scope of this milestone.

Given that the BOM has already been finalized and every part has been purchased and shipped, can you confirm that this milestone is now for the completed system layout and wiring plan, rather than another parts list to purchase from?

I also want to ensure we agree that no further components are required at this stage and that the project is proceeding into the build and integration phase.

Let me know what you think.

decisions.reason: Finalizing procurement does not change the required solenoid-controlled dispensing behavior or any of its operating constraints.
The decision that no additional components are currently required does not alter the approved 50A capacity, higher-power controllers, supported loads, or overload margin.
The milestone and procurement clarification does not change the leak-free plumbing or bowl-seal requirements.
BOM finalization and the transition to build integration leave the selected whisk and mixing-performance requirements unchanged.
The source does not change motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The procurement-stage clarification does not alter bowl removal, clearance, or rapid swapping behavior.
The source does not modify splash targets, high-speed constraints, or acceptable mitigation methods.
The finalized BOM does not change the approved speed range, maximum speed, or intended mixing modes.
Completion of component purchasing does not revoke or alter the off-the-shelf component strategy used for the prototype.
The milestone clarification does not change whisk removability, tool-free preference, or removal purposes.
